headline: Tencent gives back 5.9% of token share in a day, but DeepSeek and Tencent still own 54.7%
summary: Tencent had the sharpest provider-share drop of the day, shedding 5.9%, yet it still holds 16.0% and the No. 2 spot. DeepSeek remains the heavyweight at 38.7%, with its top model still at 29.7% of tokens.
highlights: Tencent's provider share fell 5.9% in a day, the steepest drop on the table, but it's still clinging to No. 2 at 16.0%.
StepFun's step-5-preview was the day's most dramatic climber, jumping 13 places to No. 12.
DeepSeek's deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 is still parked at No. 1 with 29.7% of tokens, showing no sign of budging.
The top two providers, DeepSeek and Tencent, hold 54.7% combined, and the top five reach 73.8%.
Two newcomers joined the top 50 (google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite and perplexity's pplx-decider), while minimax-m3 and mistral-nemo dropped out.
The records board is empty today, so there are no streaks to celebrate.
